question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The driver made an __**obscene**__ gesture at the passenger
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e., 'Decent'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"obscene"** means offensive or disgusting by accepted standards of morality and decency. (अश्लील)

 
 
• **Example:** The driver made an obscene gesture at the passenger, shocking everyone around.
 
 
 
• **"Decent"** refers to conforming with generally accepted standards of respectable or moral behavior. (सभ्य)
 
 
• **Example:** He was known for his decent behavior and courteous manners.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'obscene'** is **'decent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Decent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hilarious** (बहुत मजेदार): Extremely amusing.

 
 
• **Example:** The comedian's performance was absolutely hilarious.
 
 
 
• **Improper** (अनुचित): Not in accordance with accepted standards, especially of morality or honesty.
 
 
• **Example:** His improper remarks were not appreciated by the audience.
 
 
 
• **Mean** (नीच): Unkind, spiteful, or unfair.
 
 
• **Example:** She made a mean comment about his appearance.
